name: qSHA256, measurement-based
description: Reconstruction of the garbage-free SHA-256 circuit of the qSHA256 project in its lowest-cost configuration: every Toffoli is a temporary AND, computed once and removed by measurement (Gidney adder, rolling schedule, serial rounds, full uncomputation). Rebuilt by sha256.fail from the project's source at commit 741fe86; the project's own code was not run.
